firm_data.firm_description: Walsh Markus McDougal & DeBellis LLP is a multi-practice law firm centrally located in Nassau County in the Village of Garden City. The firm has extensive experience in matters relating to commercial and residential real estate transactions, municipal, zoning, cooperatives and condominiums, foreclosures, complex commercial litigation, personal injury litigation, estate planning and administration, and appellate practice.
notable_facts: The firm represents clients throughout Nassau, Suffolk, and Westchester County as well as any of the boroughs of New York City.
The firm represents clients in administrative and municipal hearings, State and Federal Courts, on both the trial and appellate level.

email.subject: AI for Walsh Markus McDougal & DeBellis LLP, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Kevin,

With your firm's deep expertise across real estate, zoning, and cooperative matters across Nassau, Suffolk, and Westchester, you're handling the kind of complex transactions that demand precision without the overhead of BigLaw.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in the region to meet firms like yours. I'd be happy to stop by Garden City on Thursday, April 10 to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
